commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Five-mana Mishra repeatedly makes hasty 4/4 Warform copies of owned noncreature artifacts at beginning of combat, harvesting ETB/card draw, instant activated utility and scheduled sacrifice into KCI/recursion/token-copy finishes.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 Optimized: powerful commander-centered artifact token/extra-turn loops and fast interaction, but a five-mana combat-dependent engine has vulnerability and speed constraints against true tournament cEDH.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Protect the noncreature-artifact Warform copy identity and retain the removal of generic Underworld Breach and Brain Freeze. Do not turn this into the same Oracle/Consult/Citadel pile as every Grixis shell.

whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Force of Will, Mana Drain, Offer, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Portal and Spine remain. Greaves improves commander protection but cutting Padeem loses broad artifact shroud, and Station trades away Lich's Relic multiplayer removal.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Evaluated not-only-EDHREC candidates Grinding Station, Marionette Apprentice, Roaming Throne, Braids, Copy Artifact and Memory Jar. Oracle interactions and actual retained alternative finishers controlled selection.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Full conceptual 100-card seven-change branch sacrifices unique Brudiclad token conversion for an end-step opponent-sacrifice engine; rejected as lower ceiling when opponents can sacrifice spare creatures or treasures.

Full conceptual 100-card seven-change branch adds a cheap general artifact copy but removes repeatable opponent-turn control through a hasty Mishra Warform; rejected after preserving distinctive copy target.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Brudiclad and Mindslaver were independently challenged for seventh swaps even though prior source marked KEEP; both remained stronger in their distinct end-game role.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The approved October candidate is already highly optimized and some new replacements sacrifice hard-earned multiplayer removal, broad artifact hexproof and cast reduction; six cosmetic swaps would be unacceptable.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Each selected card opens a more direct Warform trigger, activated or death conversion; retained Synthesizer/Brudiclad/KCI/Heart protects existing distinctive ceiling. The worst replacement is Lich's Relic to Station, explicitly exposed for owner review.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: Prior complete 99-card October15 structural/role ledger was reread and reconciled against the live 100-card exact approved source. Every role was classified as artifact-copy payload, engine multiplier, ETB value, sacrifice tutor/finish, graveyard loop, interaction/protection, lands/fast mana or flex. Beyond six selected cuts, retained Brudiclad, Mindslaver, Master Transmuter, Coveted Jewel, Synthesizer and the existing alt combo payoffs were materially challenged for a seventh or eighth replacement.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Braids reliably spends Warform before delayed end-step sacrifice but opponents can offer a token of either shared type; Brudiclad converts an entire existing treasure/map/servo swarm into attacking 4/4 copies of a Warform.
Copy Artifact is cheaper and allows duplicate premium artifacts but does not replace Mindslaver's unique copied hasty ability to control an opponent's next turn; no seventh swap earned.

open_ended_optimization_audit.no_credible_larger_package_reason: Two concrete seven-swap portfolios were evaluated slot by slot and recorded in heightened audit. Adding Braids while cutting Brudiclad discards the unique board-wide token-conversion finish; adding Copy Artifact while cutting Mindslaver sacrifices the distinctive repeatable control lock. Additional eighth changes using Jar/Citadel or Manufactor depended on opponents' draws, harder black mana, or extra supporting cards. None is a persuasive quality improvement; increasing the swap count alone would degrade commander identity.
open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The six replacements preserve the previously source-proven extra-turn, token-Helm, KCI and Top/Forge/Aetherflux engines and improve direct turn-to-turn Warform conversion. Remaining credible challengers were scrutinized against real retained high-impact targets, not omitted because a numeric floor was met. The removal/protection and mana-discount losses are documented; no gameplay win-rate or unsupported blanket M6 certification is inferred.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Exact 100 distinct, commander first, unchanged 34 lands, six selected adds and six source-verified cuts, all source-bound live current Scryfall Commander legal and only Grixis/colorless identities.
